name: 鴛鴦

similarSpecies.distinction: 雄鳥紅眼、綠色羽冠及白喉線，沒有橙色帆羽；北美原生同屬種。
同種雌鳥，不是另一物種：灰頭、白眼圈連幼長眼後線、胸脅淡斑。

featureNotes: 雄鳥橙褐色直立帆狀三級飛羽
紫胸與皮黃脅間有黑白直條

rangeMap.note: Full world native-country subset: NE China south to Beijing, Russian Far East breeding; Japan and Taiwan resident; China largely south of Beijing nonbreeding. Introduced European populations deliberately excluded from native map. Not whole-country coverage or complete range.

sources.use: Full substantive page read: 41-49cm male cream supercilium orange whiskers/sails, red bill, purple chest and double vertical flank boundary; female grey head cream tapered eye-line patterned flanks; native range and LC decreasing; HK escapees also occur.
Read search result: Wood Duck adult male iridescent plumage and red eyes; female white eye-ring/white throat, same genus.
Read search result: male green-blue-purple crest, white stripes and finger-like white cheek/throat extensions, red eye and patterned bill; no orange Mandarin sails.
Authoritative runtime scores; missing values remain blank; vEst flag means body length used for visibility is estimated.
